summary: Bail in economic offence involving cryptocurrency worth Rs.4 crore; 2000 investors affected; charge-sheet filed against 5 accused; trial ongoing before Chief Judicial Magistrate with 189 witnesses proposed; accused in custody since December 2023; interpretation of Section 437(6), CrPC: not mandatory but requires liberal approach; factors include delay attributable to accused, tampering, abscondence, custody duration, sentence length, trial timeline; High Court denied bail; Supreme Court grants bail considering prolonged trial, documentary evidence, no flight risk.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.420, s.201, s.120-B, s.34
